History:
45-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
No prior conventional DMARD therapy; patient prefers to start a biologic.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with moderate disease activity, CDAI 20.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
